narr: During the late afternoon and evening hours of June 3rd, a cluster of thunderstorms produced heavy rain across portions of Allamakee County, leading to a few localized mud slides.
ev: The public reported a mud slide caused a block wall to come down on X52 and the rail track next to it. Mud debris was reported to be on the train track.
A couple of small mudslides were reported near Lansing. Clear Creek was also reported to be out of its banks.
lsr: Mud slide caused a block wall to come down onto X52 and rail track. This mud debris went onto the train track below.
